I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data right now, but I can give you a rough estimate based on recent averages.

**Approximate conversion (mid‑2023):**

| Currency | Rate (USD → GBP) | Equivalent |
|----------|------------------|------------|
| $20      | 1 USD ≈ £0.78    | **≈ £15.60** |

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly due to market conditions, so the actual amount you receive when converting $20 to pounds today could differ slightly. If you need the most accurate figure, it’s best to check a reliable financial news source, your bank, or a currency‑conversion website at the time of the transaction.
